name: redslime-ondeath-sweep-stack-order-choice
notes: Regression coverage for the stacking-order-choice fix applying to a generated closure's own self-contained multi-kill effect. Red Slime's On Death ability (allyDestroyedAbilities['mttsvbgl6f:0'], GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php) deals damage equal to its own power to all allies -- a synchronous sweep entirely inside one generated closure, not via separate hand-written QueueTriggeredAbility() dispatch calls. Killed here via two casts of Charge the Soul (ra9950o14t) dealing 1 damage each to Red Slime (life 2), then its sweep deals 3 to all remaining allies, chain-killing Golden Pawn (Lewf9sfv9m, life 1, On Death: Draw) and Heavenly Drake (loSCQzxqi1, life 3, On Death: Recover 3) simultaneously. Before the fix, both On Death triggers auto-resolved in a hardcoded order with no player choice. After the fix (ResolveTopOfEffectStack() in Custom/OpportunityLogic.php now wraps its whole trigger-resolution dispatch -- including the generated CardActivated()/Fire*TriggeredAbility calls it makes -- in BeginTriggeredAbilityBatch()/EndTriggeredAbilityBatch()), player 1 is offered an MZCHOOSE (TriggerOrderPickResolve) to pick the order. No GeneratedCode files were touched or regenerated for this fix.
